description: Creates a project from a repository the person's connected code host can read, on one of their connected cloud accounts, and starts the repository scan. Nothing is deployed and nothing costs money yet. With one connected cloud you don't need to name it; otherwise pass cloud (a provider) or cloud_connection_id (from account). Then follow project's next_steps. Needs a key with Operate access.

branch.description: The branch to deploy. Default: the repository's default

name.description: The project's name. Default: the repository's name

workspace.description: Act in a teammate's workspace: its id from account. Default: your own.

name: create_project
title: Create a project
